claimText: Control of a departing aircraft shall be transferred from the unit providing aerodrome control service to the unit providing approach control service when visual meteorological conditions prevail in the vicinity of the aerodrome, as specified in letters of agreement or ATS unit instructions.
rationale: Mandatory transfer condition for departing aircraft in VMC. Specific timing sub-conditions (prior to leaving vicinity, prior to entering IMC, or at prescribed point) are alternatives within this clause.
